t: The Magnusson Beam 450 LED head torch provides reliable hands-free illumination for challenging working environments. Delivering up to 450 lumens of bright light, this battery-powered tool is ideal for electricians, plumbers and mechanics working in dark, confined spaces. The versatile unit features 4 x distinct light modes, including spot and flood options, to suit various tasks. A 60° tilt adjustment allows trade professionals to direct the light exactly where it is needed. Constructed with an IP44 splashproof rating, the durable head torch is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.
